title: Bacolod to install solar-powered street lamps with CCTV cameras

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY – A total of 150 ‘intelligent’ street lamp poles, each equipped with solar-powered LED lights, will be installed across Bacolod City, Col Eugene Rebadomia, city police director, said on Wednesday, Nov. 18. These poles will collectively carry 240 closed-circuit television (CCTV) camera attachments. The system will strengthen the city’s capacity to monitor crime incidents, traffic conditions, disasters, and other public safety concerns, while also helping prevent criminal activities, reduce road accidents, and promote safer communities, Rebadomia said.
